6 تَنَآءَشَ He, or it, became, or remained, behind; became delayed, or retarded; it became postponed; syn. تَأَخَّرَ; (S;) and so ↓ نَأَشَ , said of a man; (Bd, xxxiv. 51;) and ↓ انتأش , (S, TA,) said of an affair. (S.) ―
-b2- He, or it, became distant, or remote; or he went, removed, retired, or withdrew himself, to a distance, or far away; (S, TA;) as also ↓ انتأش . (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, in three places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
